shadowGuess.name: Guess the Shadow
shadowGuess.instructions: Look at the silhouette and choose, among four creatures, the one you think is hiding behind it.

blocked.insufficientCatalog: Guess the Shadow isn't available yet: it needs at least 12 approved creatures that are visually distinguishable from each other to unlock this mode.

imaginedSoundNotice.heading: An imagined sound
imaginedSoundNotice.message: These sounds are imagined. No one knows for certain what these creatures really sounded like: no real sound has ever been preserved. This sound is an imagined creation made for the game, not a recording or a scientific reconstruction.

oidoJurasico.playButtonAriaLabel: Play the imagined sound for this round
oidoJurasico.replayButtonAriaLabel: Listen again to the imagined sound for this round

mutedNotice.heading: Sound is muted
mutedNotice.message: Jurassic Hearing needs sound turned on to play. Turn it on to hear this round's clue.

playbackError.message: Jurassic Hearing can't continue because the sound couldn't be played. You can go back to the game selector and try another mode.

answerReinforcement.message: Remember: this sound is an imagined interpretation, not a proven scientific reconstruction.

timeline.instruction: In which period did this creature live? Choose Triassic, Jurassic, or Cretaceous.
timeline.roundChangeAnnouncementFormat: Round {current} of {total}. In which period did {dinosaur} live?

feedback.correct: Correct! It lived mainly in the {periodo}.
feedback.incorrect: That's not correct. It lived mainly in the {periodo}.

classificationFormat.reptil_volador: {dinosaur} was a flying reptile, not a dinosaur.
classificationFormat.otro: {dinosaur} is not a dinosaur or a flying reptile.

blockedRound.message: We couldn't verify this creature's period yet. Let's try another round!
blockedRound.announcementFormat: Round blocked: we couldn't verify {dinosaur}'s period yet. Let's try another round.

gameOver.heading: Timeline complete!
gameOver.message: Great job exploring when each creature lived! Keep playing to discover more.
gameOver.announcementFormat: You finished Timeline. You got {score} of {total} rounds right.

locked.message: Timeline isn't available because there aren't enough valid creature cards to complete a game.
